description: This file defines Express routes for controlling and querying the status of smart lights, including endpoints for getting status, turning lights on/off, changing color, and adjusting brightness. It also includes Swagger API documentation annotations.

methods.name: GET /light/:deviceId/status
methods.description: Fetches the current status of a specified light device, including on/off state, color, and brightness.

methods.name: POST /light/:deviceId/on
methods.description: Turns the specified light device on.

methods.name: POST /light/:deviceId/off
methods.description: Turns the specified light device off.

methods.name: POST /light/:deviceId/color
methods.description: Changes the color of the specified light device, requiring a 'color' parameter in the request body.

methods.name: POST /light/:deviceId/brightness
methods.description: Adjusts the brightness of the specified light device, requiring a 'brightness' parameter in the request body.
